children.name: Evidence
children.value: The blocks hold a new config block, which libwavpack has written since 5.0; libwavpack reports encoder version 5 for a file with one

findings.message: The first audio block at 0x0 gives a DSD bit rate of 2147483647 Hz times 2^31 times 8, more than the 2147483647 Hz a sample rate can hold; the report takes it as 2147483647 Hz.
